title: Conditional Type 2
subtitle: Câu điều kiện loại 2 — Không có thật ở hiện tại

meta.prevUnitConnection: Type 1 nói về tình huống có thể xảy ra. Type 2 nói về tình huống KHÔNG CÓ THẬT.

goalBlock.speaking: Dùng Type 2 trong Part 3 để đưa ra ý kiến giả thuyết — thể hiện tư duy phân tích cao.
goalBlock.writing: Dùng Type 2 trong Task 2 để lập luận về tình huống lý tưởng hoặc phản biện.

theory.coreRule: Conditional Type 2: IF + Past Simple, would + V nguyên mẫu. Tình huống KHÔNG CÓ THẬT ở hiện tại/tương lai. Đặc biệt: If I/he/she/it were... (văn trang trọng dùng were). KHÔNG dùng would trong mệnh đề if.

grammarForSpeaking.wrong: If every country would reduce emissions by 50%, climate change would slow.
grammarForSpeaking.correct: If every country reduced emissions by 50%, climate change would slow significantly.
grammarForSpeaking.tipVi: KHÔNG dùng 'would' trong mệnh đề 'if' của Type 2. Mệnh đề if dùng Past Simple.
grammarForSpeaking.bandImpact: Phân biệt đúng Type 1 (if + present) và Type 2 (if + past) là điều kiện để đạt Grammatical Range band 6.5.

quickExamples.en: If world leaders were more united, global problems would be easier to solve.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu các nhà lãnh đạo đoàn kết hơn, các vấn đề toàn cầu sẽ dễ giải quyết hơn.

quickExamples.en: If I were the prime minister, I would prioritize investment in renewable energy.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu tôi là thủ tướng, tôi sẽ ưu tiên đầu tư vào năng lượng tái tạo.

quickExamples.en: Developing nations could catch up economically if they received more equitable trade opportunities.
quickExamples.vi: Các nước đang phát triển có thể bắt kịp nếu nhận được cơ hội thương mại công bằng hơn.

commonMistakes.incorrect: If I was the president, I will change immigration policies.
commonMistakes.correct: If I were the president, I would change immigration policies.
commonMistakes.explanationVi: Type 2: if-clause dùng were (văn trang trọng). Mệnh đề chính: would (not will).

commonMistakes.incorrect: If countries would cooperate more, poverty would decrease.
commonMistakes.correct: If countries cooperated more, poverty would decrease.
commonMistakes.explanationVi: KHÔNG dùng would trong mệnh đề if — lỗi cực phổ biến. Dùng Past Simple.

commonMistakes.incorrect: The world would be safer if tensions between nations will reduce.
commonMistakes.correct: The world would be safer if tensions between nations reduced.
commonMistakes.explanationVi: Dù if-clause đứng sau mệnh đề chính — vẫn phải dùng Past Simple (reduced).

items.question: Câu Conditional Type 2 nào đúng?
options: If more people would use public transport, air pollution would decrease.
If more people used public transport, air pollution would decrease.
If more people use public transport, air pollution would decrease.
If more people used public transport, air pollution will decrease.
items.correctAnswer: If more people used public transport, air pollution would decrease.
items.feedbackCorrect: Đúng! Type 2: If + Past Simple (used) + would + V nguyên mẫu (decrease). Giả thuyết — hiện tại không đủ người dùng phương tiện công cộng.
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: If + Past Simple (used — không would, không use) + would + V. Không dùng will trong câu chính của Type 2.
items.ieltsTip: Nhận biết Type 2: câu nói về tình huống NGƯỢC LẠI thực tế. 'If I were richer' = nhưng thực ra tôi không giàu.

items.question: Part 3 — 'If you could change one thing about global economic policy, what would it be?' Câu trả lời nào đúng?
options: If I can change one thing, I will reduce trade barriers.
If I could change one thing, I would reduce trade barriers between developing nations.
If I would change one thing, I would reduce trade barriers.
If I changed one thing, I will reduce trade barriers.
items.correctAnswer: If I could change one thing, I would reduce trade barriers between developing nations.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'If I could' = giả thuyết (could = Past Simple của can). 'I would reduce' = mệnh đề chính. Câu trả lời Part 3 band 6.0!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: If + Past Simple/could (giả thuyết) + would + V. 'If I could' là dạng giả thuyết lịch sự.
items.ieltsTip: Part 3 hay hỏi 'If you could..., what would you...?' Học thuộc: 'If I could + V, I would + V because...'

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'If wealthy nations would share their medical technology, developing countries would overcome health crises more effectively. If there was more international solidarity, fewer people will die.'
options: would share → shared; will die → would die; was → were
would share → shared only
will die → would die only
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: would share → shared; will die → would die; was → were
items.feedbackCorrect: Ba điểm: (1) would share → shared (if-clause dùng Past Simple). (2) will die → would die (mệnh đề chính Type 2). (3) was → were (văn trang trọng).
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2 toàn câu: if-clause = Past Simple (not would), main clause = would (not will). 'If there were' dùng were thay was trong văn học thuật.
items.ieltsTip: 'If there were more...' (not was) là chuẩn trong Task 2 học thuật — dùng 'were' cho mọi chủ ngữ trong văn viết trang trọng.

items.question: Điền đúng: 'If the international community _____ (adopt) a unified approach to cybersecurity, global digital infrastructure _____ (be) far more secure.'
options: adopted / would be
would adopt / would be
adopts / would be
adopted / will be
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Adopted' = Past Simple trong if-clause (Type 2). 'Would be' = kết quả giả thuyết. Câu Task 2 học thuật!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: if + Past Simple (adopted — không would adopt) + would + V (would be — không will be).
items.ieltsTip: Type 2 trong Task 2 phù hợp để nói về tình huống lý tưởng: 'If [ideal condition existed], [positive outcome] would follow.'

items.question: Tạo câu Part 3: [were / nations / all / if / committed / equality / gender / to / be / disparities / global / would / reduce]
options: If all nations were committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
If all nations would be committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
If all nations were committed to gender equality, global disparities will reduce.
All nations if were committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
items.correctAnswer: If all nations were committed to gender equality, global disparities would reduce.
items.feedbackCorrect: Hoàn hảo! 'Were committed' = Past Simple Passive trong if-clause (Type 2). 'Would reduce' = mệnh đề chính. Band 6.5+!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 2: if + were committed (Past Simple Passive — không would be) + would + V (reduce — không will).
items.ieltsTip: Kết hợp Type 2 + Passive: 'If + were/were + V3 + ..., would + V' — ngữ pháp rất phức tạp và ấn tượng.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 dùng Type 2 về tình huống lý tưởng trong quan hệ quốc tế.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: If richer nations reduced their carbon footprints, developing countries would...
writingMini.modelAnswer: If richer nations reduced their carbon footprints drastically, developing countries would have more room to grow their economies without bearing the full burden of climate responsibility.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'If you were a world leader, what global problem would you prioritize?' Dùng Type 2.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: If I were a world leader, I would make climate change my top priority. I would push for a binding international agreement requiring all major economies to transition to renewable energy within 20 years. If such a commitment existed, I believe we would have a genuinely sustainable future.

completion.nextUnitConnection: Type 2 = không có thật hiện tại. Type 3 = không có thật trong QUÁ KHỨ — nói về điều đã không xảy ra. Đây là cấu trúc phức tạp nhất.
